recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆胞質深藍的大型紅血球前驅細胞，染色體呈帶狀排列（有絲分裂中期），周圍有數個核深染、輪廓呈不規則分葉或出芽狀的紅血球母細胞，提示紅血球系發育不良（dyserythropoiesis）。
features: Large basophilic erythroblast with deeply blue cytoplasm and condensed chromosomes aligned in a band, consistent with a cell in metaphase
Several erythroid precursors with dense, irregular, lobulated or budding nuclear contours and small clear vacuole-like spaces, suggestive of nuclear budding/karyorrhexis
Polychromatic erythroblasts with round nuclei, coarse chromatin and grey-blue cytoplasm
Occasional orthochromatic erythroblast with pyknotic nucleus
Background red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Giemsa stain, high power) shows erythroid precursors at various stages of maturation. A large basophilic erythroblast is in metaphase, and several erythroblasts have dense, irregularly lobulated or budding nuclear outlines, suggestive of nuclear budding and karyorrhexis. Polychromatic and orthochromatic erythroblasts with coarse chromatin are also present. Findings are suggestive of dyserythropoiesis; in the context of myelodysplastic syndrome, at least 10% dysplastic erythroid cells should be documented across the smear, along with iron stain and cytogenetic correlation.

ddx.vs: B12/folate deficiency causes nuclear irregularity with open, sieve-like chromatin and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony plus giant metamyelocytes, and resolves with replacement.
CDA presents in young patients with isolated erythroid dysplasia (binucleation, internuclear bridging) and no clonal or other-lineage abnormalities.

ddx.dx: Reactive erythroid changes (drugs, alcohol, HIV, heavy metals)
ddx.vs: Non-clonal dyserythropoiesis lacks cytogenetic or molecular abnormalities and reverses after removing the cause.
Mitotic figures are normal in erythroid hyperplasia, so dysplasia must rest on irregular nuclear budding, multinucleation or megaloblastoid change rather than mitoses alone.
